transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

I came because… people keep saying I’m just imagining things, but I’m not. The hospital people, and some people from the agency, they’ve been watching our house and my cleaning routes. I think they’re checking whether I’m taking proper care of my husband.
Can you tell me more about these people watching you? How long have you felt this way, and have you noticed any specific behaviors or signs that make you believe they are monitoring you?

It’s been going on long enough that I can’t just ignore it. I don’t really want to get into every detail, but… I notice people around the house, and then it feels like the same kind of thing happens when I’m out on my cleaning routes.

It’s hospital people, and some people from the agency. They act like it’s nothing, but I know they’re checking up on me—watching to see if I’m taking care of my husband right.
Have you ever seen, heard, or sensed things that others don’t seem to notice, like voices or presences, even when you’re alone?

Sometimes… yes. When the house is quiet, I hear a woman’s voice near the kitchen window. She’ll tell me to check the locks, or move my husband’s pills. It sounds clear, like she’s standing right there.
Have others, like your husband or friends, ever heard this woman’s voice or confirmed that she’s actually there when you’ve heard her?

No… not really. My husband doesn’t seem to hear it. It’s usually when the house is quiet, by the kitchen window. I hear her clear, telling me to check the locks or move his pills, but… other people don’t say they hear anything.
Do you believe that these people watching you are part of a larger plan or conspiracy to control or harm you in some way?

I don’t know if I’d call it some big conspiracy… but it feels organized enough. The hospital people, and some people from the agency, they keep watching the house and even my cleaning routes. They want to see if I’m taking care of my husband the right way. I know people say I’m imagining it, but I’m not.
Do you ever feel that your actions, thoughts, or feelings are being controlled by someone or something outside of yourself?

Not controlled exactly… I don’t like that word. But I’m here because people keep saying I’m imagining things, and I know the hospital people and some agency folks have been watching our house… and my cleaning routes. Like they’re checking if I’m taking proper care of my husband.
Do you feel that these people watching you are acting with harmful intent, or do you think they’re just keeping an eye on you for some reason they haven’t explained?

I don’t know if they mean to hurt me exactly. It’s more like… they’re watching to catch something. The hospital people, maybe agency people too, checking the house and where I clean, to see if I’m taking care of my husband right. That’s why I’m here, because everyone keeps saying I’m imagining it.
Do you think these people watching you are acting based on something that most other people would find unusual or hard to believe?

Maybe other people think it’s hard to believe, yeah. That’s why I’m here, I guess. But I know what I’ve seen… hospital people, and some agency folks, watching the house and even where I clean, like they’re checking if I’m taking care of my husband right.
Do you believe that these people watching you are targeting you specifically, or do you think they are involved in some way that also affects other people around you?

It feels like it’s me they’re looking at, mostly. Our house, my cleaning routes… like they’re checking whether I’m taking proper care of my husband. Other people may be involved, but I’m the one they’re watching.

Do you think there could be a different explanation for what you’re experiencing, like someone checking on things by coincidence or misunderstanding, or do you believe it’s definitely the hospital and agency people watching you specifically?

I mean… people say maybe I’m misunderstanding, but I don’t think so. I know what I’ve seen. The hospital people, and some agency people, they’ve been watching our house and where I clean… like they’re checking if I’m taking care of my husband right.
Have you ever questioned whether these experiences might be due to your own worries or stress, rather than actual people watching you?

I’ve wondered, I guess… because people keep saying that. But it doesn’t feel like just stress to me. I know what I’ve seen—the hospital people and some agency folks watching the house and where I clean, like they’re checking on how I care for my husband.
Do you feel completely certain that these hospital and agency people are watching you, even when others say there’s no evidence for it?

Yes… I feel pretty sure. I know people keep saying there’s no evidence, but I’m here because they act like I’m imagining it. I’ve seen the hospital people and some agency people around our house and my cleaning routes, like they’re checking on how I take care of my husband.
Have you ever felt that something about the world around you feels strange or altered, like there’s a general sense that something is off or not quite right?
I don’t know… not really like that. I mean, things feel tense sometimes, but I wouldn’t say the whole world feels strange or changed.
Have you ever believed something that most people would find very strange or impossible, like thoughts being put into your mind, or technology being used to control your actions?

Not like… thoughts put in my head or being controlled, no. It’s more that I know people think I’m imagining things, but I’ve seen hospital people and agency folks watching our house and where I clean, like they’re checking if I’m taking care of my husband right.

Have you ever believed something strongly that others have told you isn’t true, even when they’ve given you evidence against it, not just about being watched but about anything else that’s happened to you?

Mostly this. People say I’m wrong, that there’s no proof, but… I know what I’ve seen. The hospital people, and some agency folks, watching around our house and where I clean. Like they’re checking if I’m taking care of my husband right.

Have you ever been absolutely certain about something that others have told you isn't true, not related to being watched, where you still believed it was real even after they tried to convince you otherwise?
No… I don’t think so. Not that I can remember. It’s mostly just been what I already told you.
